moveFolderToPersonal: Only you will see this folder and its name. The pages inside keep their own sharing.
moveFolderToShared: Everyone in the organization will see this folder and its name. The pages inside keep their own sharing.

name: Name
renameConflict: Someone saved this page meanwhile. Open it to see their version, then rename it.
refusalFolderScope: You cannot organise folders. Ask an admin for access.

refusalSyncedMarker: This description is reserved for synced folders.
refusalNotYourFolder: A personal folder can only be your own.
refusalSubfolderSection: A folder is seen by whoever sees the folder it is in. Move it out first.

trash.title: Trash
trash.intro: Pages wait here for 30 days, then they are deleted for good. Anyone who can edit a page can restore it.
trash.deleteConfirmBody: The page, its files and its history are removed. This cannot be undone.
trash.keptHint: Archived before Trash existed: never deleted automatically.
trash.cannotTrash: You cannot move this page to Trash.
trash.syncedRefused: This page is synced from another source: manage it there.
trash.cannotDelete: You cannot delete this page for good.
trash.onlyAdmins: Only an administrator can delete a page for good.
trash.notInTrash: Restore this page and move it to Trash again before deleting it for good.
trash.purgeIncomplete: This page could not be deleted for good. It stays in Trash.
trash.unsavedRefused: Your latest text is not saved yet. Try again once it is.
trash.failed: That did not work. Try again.
